alerts.headline: Capitulation wash-out — bounce setup
alerts.headline_zh: 投降式洗盘 — 反弹布局
alerts.detail: Aggregate SOPR capitulation (z≤−1.5) after a deep drop — reactive bounce setup. BTC $66,658.
alerts.detail_zh: 深跌之后总体 SOPR 投降（z≤−1.5）— 反应式反弹布局。 BTC $66,658.
alerts.edge: Capitulation wash-out (SOPR). REACTIVE — fires AFTER a deep drop and leads the BOUNCE by ~2d; it is NOT a pre-emptive bottom call.
alerts.edge_zh: 投降式洗盘（SOPR）。反应式 — 在大幅下跌之后触发，领先反弹约 2 天；并非提前抄底信号。
